model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training for several language models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 1440000, with tick intervals of 20000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, is also linear and extends from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with tick intervals of 0.1. A solid red line represents “Vanilla”, beginning at a loss value of approximately 2.9 and decreasing to a loss value of approximately 2.7. A dashed orange line represents “StrmLLM (n=64)”, starting at approximately 3.1 and decreasing towards 2.9. A solid blue line represents “SepLLM (n=64)”, beginning at approximately 3.1 and decreasing to a loss value of approximately 2.9. A solid green line represents “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, starting at approximately 3.2 and declining to roughly 2.9. A solid magenta line represents “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, beginning at approximately 3.2 and decreasing to approximately 2.9. A solid dark blue line represents “SepLLM (n=128)”, starting at approximately 3.2 and decreasing to a loss value of approximately 2.8.
